
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/uoky/p/19672633" title="发布于 2026-03-05 13:52">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Copilot 命令行使用方式介绍（npm）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">前提：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">　　node&nbsp; v22</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">　　npm v10+&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">官网特性介绍地址：<a href="https://github.com/features/copilot/cli" rel="noopener nofollow">GitHub Copilot CLI</a></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">一个博主写的介绍文档地址：<a href="https://global.hitachi-solutions.com/blog/github-copilot-cli-boost-developer-productivity-in-the-terminal/" rel="noopener nofollow">GitHub Copilot CLI：提升终端开发者生产力——日立解决方案</a></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">这个更复杂，介绍的更多，我这里只是极简介绍（以及曾经还有一个旧版，这里只介绍新版）</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305134810961-1401813406.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_13-47-58" width="682" height="190" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;我本地是：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305134853301-562587279.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_13-48-49" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;步骤：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">1. 安装copilot命令行工具（旧版需要单独安装，新版直接使用npm安装）</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:python;gutter:true;"><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">npm install -g @github/copilot
</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">　　</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305134926730-538417327.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_13-49-24" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">使用：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">1. 命令行，输入copilot，信任当前工作目录等</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305135024683-1250420215.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305135051936-1480732271.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px"><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">&nbsp;2. 登录，在输入框中，输入 /login</span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 幼圆; font-size: 18px">使用Github登录即可（跳转到Github，此时粘贴板内已复制实时Code，只需要粘贴到网页上即可）</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305135947515-81978020.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_13-59-43" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305140002809-425000486.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_13-59-59" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305140228647-1425926556.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_14-02-25" width="1074" height="151" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305140429385-1889442943.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_14-04-25" width="985" height="404" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305140651147-1635038841.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_14-06-39" width="968" height="537" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305140744090-1546701512.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_14-07-41" width="892" height="698" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305140824956-1743260652.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_14-08-22" width="835" height="361" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305140956600-192128086.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_14-09-52" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;3. 可以正常使用了，至于模型，就自行选择（我使用的是免费的，收费的就自行订阅）</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2115870/202603/2115870-20260305141949237-197200762.png" alt="PixPin_2026-03-05_14-19-44" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;其中有一些概念，比如模式有哪些模式，各个模式的区别之类的，各个模型的特点之类的，这里就不介绍了。</p>

</div>
